_comment: Copy the 'mcp' and 'plugin' keys you want into your real opencode.json (~/.config/opencode/opencode.json for global, or ./.opencode/opencode.json for project). This file is just a ready-to-paste example for the osmeng-agent-starter add-ons.

_notes.chrome-devtools: Requires Chrome stable + Node LTS. Remove --browser-url flag to let MCP launch Chrome itself. Set enabled:false to disable without deleting.
_notes.context7: Alternative to the remote MCP: run 'npx ctx7 setup --opencode' which auto-configures, OR keep the plugin '@upstash/context7-opencode' without the remote entry. Don't enable both at once if they duplicate tools.
_notes.supersubagents: Node 18+. Pure MCP (no SKILL.md). Provides spawn/cancel/launch-* tools with Codex/Copilot/Claude backends.
_notes.superpowers: Also installs 14 SKILL.md files via install.sh; the plugin and the file copy coexist. Remove either if you prefer one mechanism.
_notes.agent-swarm: No MCP entry needed for OpenCode — its 19 skills (spawn/orchestrate/...) work as plain SKILL.md files. For Claude Code only: 'claude plugin install agent-swarm'.
_notes.gh: No MCP — it's a CLI. Install via winget/brew and auth with 'gh auth login'. Skills 'gh' + 'gh-skill' are already installed.
